data.one_liner: Exposes Tailwind CSS color palettes for use in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to TailwindCSS, TailwindUI, and Tailwind v3 color palettes in Dart and Flutter. Allows colors and swatches to be used similarly to Material colors and inside themes.
use_when: You want to use Tailwind CSS color palettes in your Flutter application
You need to convert Tailwind colors into MaterialColor swatches for ThemeData
avoid_when: You require dynamic parsing of Tailwind configuration files at runtime
strengths: Supports multiple Tailwind color palette versions (TailwindCSS, TailwindUI, Tailwind 2.0, and Tailwind v3)
Provides Material Color swatch conversion support
weaknesses: Parser for tailwind configuration files is still in the TODO list and not documented as implemented
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import tailwind_colors.dart.
data.minimal_example:
Color myColor = TWColors.gray.shade100;
Color mySecondColor = TWColors.blue.shade900;
